description: Registry of the Figma sources of design truth. The Design role syncs published variables/components from these into design/tokens/ via the Figma MCP.

studio810-foundation.name: Studio 810 — DS-001 Foundation
studio810-foundation.scopeHint: Four pages: Foundation (0:1) holds the variable collections, text styles and the Button sets; Global (36:2), Patterns (36:3) and Provenance (36:4) were added in run 3 to organise whole-site coverage (approved at Checkpoint 1, 2026-08-31). All content is studio810.* scope. Brand values measured from the live wearestudio810.com site via getComputedStyle (desktop values captured at a 1440px viewport, stable >= 1400px; 375px values recorded in each component spec but modelled only where the component is structurally different there). Provenance selectors are recorded in every text style description and in the descriptions of variables created from run 3 onward; the 34 variables from runs 1-2 carry no description — their provenance lives in the PRs that landed them. See findings.
studio810-foundation.contains: studio810 design system foundation: five variable collections (color, radius, space, type, border), each single-mode 'Light', totalling 39 variables, ten text styles, and three component sets.

Button/Primary.bindings: Size=Default (unchanged from run 2): fills, text fill, all four corner radii, all four paddings (space/control-x, space/control-y), fontFamily, fontSize and fontWeight bound to studio810 variables; the label's lineHeight is left AUTO, which resolves to the measured 21px for PT Serif 16px. Size=Compact is identical except that paddings bind to space/control-x-sm and space/control-y-sm and the label's lineHeight binds to type/line-control-sm (27px). Fills by state: Default and Focused use action-fill; Hover uses action-fill-hover at Size=Default and action-fill at Size=Compact; Disabled uses action-fill-disabled. Both Focused variants carry a 'Focus Ring' rectangle with stroke colour, per-side stroke weights (border/focus-ring) and corner radii (radius/control) bound - Size=Default strokes color/border-focus, Size=Compact strokes color/border-focus-brand. The ring's +/-6px placement equals focus-ring + focus-offset, positional geometry Figma cannot bind to variables. Audited run 3: zero unbound raw values across all 8 variants.
Button/Primary.deviations: CORRECTION (run 3): the run-2 note claimed the live site defines exactly one control size. That was wrong. button.sqs-add-to-cart-button (the /membership Apply button) is padding 12.8px 19.2px with a 27px label line box, against 24px 35.2px and a 21px line box for .btn. A Size(Default|Compact) axis was added and the four original variant node IDs were preserved by renaming rather than rebuilding. Approved by Ryan at Gate A, 2026-08-31; there were zero instances in the file at the time, so the API change had no blast radius. A Shape axis is still intentionally omitted - radius/control 15px is the only shape the site serves. Size=Compact, State=Hover is deliberately pixel-identical to State=Default: the applicable rule is .sqs-editable-button:hover{opacity:1}, and the opacity:.8 hover belongs to .btn, which this button does not carry. MEASURED, not an oversight. Size=Compact's two derived states were derived for the dark-green #495a58 surface it is the only button to render on: the focus ring strokes border-focus-inverse (white) because border-focus #303636 would be near-invisible there, while the disabled fill keeps action-fill-disabled #ddab97 even though that value is the white-backdrop flatten of action-fill at 80% - over #495a58 the same rule yields #b88a76. Ryan chose one hover/disabled token plus a recorded caveat over a second token (decision 3, Checkpoint 1). CORRECTION (same run): an earlier version of this note claimed Focused was DERIVED because no :focus-visible rule existed. That was wrong - the reader had missed three universal rules in the served CSS: ':focus{outline-offset:4px}', ':focus,a:focus{outline-width:2px;outline-style:solid}' and ':focus,a:focus{outline-color:var(--navigationLinkColor)}', gated by ':focus:not(:focus-visible){outline:none}'. Focused is therefore MEASURED, and border/focus-ring 2px and border/focus-offset 4px are measured values, not inventions - the ring's -6px inset (2+4) is correct. What is theme-dependent is the ring COLOUR, since --navigationLinkColor resolves per section theme: #303636 on white and light-bold, #ffffff on bright and the site default, #d4967d on dark-bold. Size=Compact strokes border-focus-brand #d4967d because /membership section 2, the only place the compact button appears, is dark-bold. Size=Default keeps border-focus #303636, correct for the white and light-bold sections where most primary buttons sit but not for the dark sections - a single-variant component cannot carry a theme-dependent colour, recorded as a known limitation pending the Theme-axis decision that belongs with the section components. Disabled remains genuinely DERIVED: no :disabled or sold-out rule exists for any of these selectors. Build hazard recorded for future components: Figma's clone() does not carry componentPropertyReferences, so the four Compact labels initially lost Label#13:0 and it was restored explicitly; every build from here asserts it. The component hugs its label (Size=Compact 88.4x52.6); the live Apply button renders 382.64px wide because its wrapper is display:block and the button is max-width:100% - width is container-driven, not a property of the button.

Button/Inverse.bindings: clone of Button/Primary's structure; each variant: fills, text fill, all four corner radii, all four paddings, fontFamily, fontSize, fontWeight bound to studio810 variables (Default/Focused fill action-inverse-fill; Hover action-inverse-fill-hover; Disabled action-inverse-fill-disabled; labels action-inverse-text; Focus Ring stroke color border-focus-inverse). The set container's own fill is bound to color/surface-2 — the bright-theme terracotta backdrop the inverse button lives on — so white variants are visible on canvas.
Button/Inverse.deviations: Same as Button/Primary: no Size/Shape axes (single measured size and shape). Hover/Disabled share a value because the live site renders both states as opacity .8; the label keeps action-inverse-text in those states because its color equals the flatten backdrop, making the flatten a mathematical no-op on the text. Approved by Ryan 2026-08-31 ("add the inverse button too").

Link/Inline.bindings: Each variant is a transparent hug/hug auto-layout frame holding one TEXT node carrying the Label#49:0 property. Type comes from the UI/Link text style, whose fontSize, fontFamily and fontWeight bind to studio810/type/size-body, family-body and weight-regular. Link colour is set on the node, not the style, because it is the one property that varies by theme: Theme=Default binds color/action-fill (#d4967d), Theme=Brand binds color/action-inverse-fill (#ffffff). The set container's fill binds to color/surface-1 so both variants are legible on canvas - a review affordance, not a property of the component; the variant frames themselves are transparent, matching the measured background-color rgba(0,0,0,0).
Link/Inline.deviations: Underline thickness (1px) and offset (0.2em, stored as 20% of font size) live on the UI/Link text style as raw values because Figma's bindable text fields do not include textDecoration* - the same class of limitation as the focus ring's positional geometry. studio810/border/underline-offset (=20) documents the value for the code mirror rather than driving Figma, and is a percent among px-valued siblings in that collection; studio810/type would be the more coherent home, left where Checkpoint 1 put it. Build hazard recorded: setting textDecoration directly on a TEXT node that has a text style applied is silently discarded - the style owns the property - which is why UI/Link exists rather than node-level decoration. No State axis: inline links have no hover (the p a:hover rule is scoped to .tweak-global-animations-animation-type-flex and the body carries -type-fade), and their focus outline comes from the global :focus rule rather than from this component, so it is recorded in the style description rather than modelled as a variant. Theme(Default|Brand) covers the two measured link colours; Default is correct on the white, light-bold, dark-bold and site-default themes, Brand only on bright.

pendingPublish: Run 3 built these into the file but a library publish is a Figma UI action with no Plugin API equivalent (figma.publishAsync does not exist; figma.teamLibrary is read-only). Unpublished as of this commit: variables studio810/space/control-x-sm, studio810/space/control-y-sm, studio810/type/line-control-sm, studio810/color/border-focus-brand, studio810/border/underline-offset; the Size property and the four Size=Compact variants on Button/Primary (13:3); the UI/Link text style; and the whole Link/Inline set (49:8). design/tokens/studio810/tokens.json is deliberately NOT synced until that publish lands, so the mirror never carries unpublished values.
